info.name: Xe.Api.Payments
Permission
Gets all permissions for the current user.

items.docs:
Sample request:
            
    GET /permissions
            
\
<details><summary>**The complete set of permissions are**</summary>
* OnlineCardSettlementEnabled
* CanQuote
* CanQuoteAndCreateTransaction
* CanUseOnlineDealing
* CanAccessRecipients
* CanEditOwnAddress
* CanAddRecipient
* CanDeleteRecipient
* ViewPaymentsAwaitingAuthorisation
* CanSubmitPayment
* AllowOnlineForwards
</details>

info.name: PurposesOfPayment

    Get /purposesofpayment/INR

\

info.name: Quote
Creates a quote for the currencies and amount provided.

items.docs:
Sample request:
            
    POST /quotes
            
\
Required user rights:
            
    CanQuote

info.name: Refreshes a quote to gain an up-to-date quote.

params.name: quoteId
params.description: ID of the quote to be refreshed.

params.name: refresh
params.description: Set to false to return a cached quote if available, or 404 if no cached quote is found.

items.docs:
Sample request:
            
    GET /quotes/Quote_123456-1234
    GET /quotes/Quote_123456-1234?refresh=false
\
Required user rights:
            
    CanQuote

info.name: Updates a quote to change or add more details.

params.name: quoteId
params.description: ID of the quote to be updated.

items.docs:
Sample request:
            
    PATCH /quotes/Quote_123456-1234
            
\
Required user rights:
            
    CanQuote

info.name: Recipient
Gets recipients for a currency.

params.name: currency
params.description: Get recipients for a specific currency.

items.docs:
Sample requests:
            
    GET /recipients?currency=GBP
            
\
Required user rights:
            
    CanAccessRecipients

info.name: Creates a recipient with the details provided.

items.docs:
Sample request:
            
    POST /recipients
            
\
Required user rights:
            
    CanAddRecipient

info.name: Delete a recipient.

params.name: recipientId
params.description: Recipient ID of recipient to delete.

items.docs:
Sample request:
            
    DELETE /recipients/{recipientId}
            
\
Required user rights:
            
    CanDeleteRecipient

info.name: Gets all recipient field definitions for a user for a specified currency and a country.

params.name: country
params.description: Country code to get recipient field definitions for.

params.name: currency
params.description: Currency code to get recipient field definitions for.

items.docs:
Sample request:
            
    GET /recipients/fields/AU/GBP
            
\
Required user rights:
            
    CanAccessRecipients
            
\
<details><summary>**Names and descriptions for the fields that can be returned**</summary>
*   ibanOrAccountNumber - Used if either an IBAN, or an domestic Account Number can be provided.

info.name: TradeableCurrency
Get tradeable currencies.
Transaction
Gets a list of transactions for the specified page number and page size, filtered by creation date.

params.name: pageNumber
params.description: The page to return (First page is page 0).

params.name: pageSize
params.description: The number of transactions per page.

params.name: toDate
params.description: Date to get transactions up to.

items.docs:

\

    CanQuoteAndCreateTransaction

info.name: Gets a transaction with the specified ID.

params.name: transactionId
params.description: ID of the transaction to get.
